scope: complete visible item assembly, including all parts, caps and hardware

melee.selection: Choose by length and overall size; smaller weapons start near the lower end.

firearm.selection: Choose by overall size and type, including pistol, SMG and rifle; smaller firearms start near the lower end.

notes: These are adjustable starting targets, not final performance-qualified limits.
Select an exact per-model cap and part allocation in a fresh family profile before processing.
Shadow budgets are separate and unchanged by this policy.

Native resource contracts, supported assemblies and client validation remain required; the firearm and shield route cap is enforced at 15000 visible / 500 shadow (contracts.FIXED_ROUTE_BUDGET) until a larger cap is qualified.

2026-11-11: the user raised every visible budget by 50% (melee 5000-15000 -> 7500-22500, firearm 10000-25000 -> 15000-37500, fixed route cap 10000 -> 15000). Items already processed keep their counts until they are reprocessed under a new profile.
